description: License classes for per-record SPDX labeling and partitioned packaging. 'license' fields hold an SPDX id or one of the pseudo-ids below.

share-alike.obligations: viral per record: ships only in share-alike-labeled partitions; derived open datasets inherit

proprietary.obligations: owner-scoped use only (e.g. a world producer's generated-world exports); never in open releases

personal.obligations: the user's own data; follows the personal tier containment rules

rules: A record with an unknown/blank license is INVALID at every boundary — producers must resolve, never default silently.
Pack/export license manifests must partition counts by class; consumers reject classes outside their configured allowlist with a per-record report.

A pseudo-id is a registered string, not an SPDX license-list identifier. Besides the ecosystem pseudo-ids (PROPRIETARY, PERSONAL), a producer may register an id of the form LicenseRef-<producer>-<idstring>, where <producer> names the registering producer. A registered id classes only where it is listed under a class's pseudoIds; an unlisted LicenseRef- id is unknown under the first rule.

A proprietary id, whether PROPRIETARY or a producer-registered pseudo-id, is a use label: it says where a record may go (the class's obligations) and asserts no copyright, ownership or authorship in the record's content. The license class neither makes nor implies such a claim.
